Log in again when a saved login stopped working

Related commands:
  auth refresh
  auth status

Output:
  Shows text you can read in your terminal.
  Use --json to get JSON for scripts and other programs.
  Use --jq to filter the JSON output with a jq expression.
  Use --template to format the output with a Go template.

Usage:
  maildo auth repair <name> [flags]

Examples:
maildo auth repair work
maildo auth repair personal --gmail-client-id CLIENT_ID
maildo auth repair hosted --imap-host imap.example.net --imap-port 993 --imap-tls implicit --smtp-host smtp.example.net --smtp-port 465 --smtp-tls implicit
maildo auth repair work --device-code
maildo auth repair work --dry-run
maildo auth repair work --json

Flags:
      --ca-file string           Certificate authority (PEM file) to trust in addition to the system's
      --device-code              Sign in with a code on another device, for machines without a browser
      --email string             Your email address; maildo looks up the servers from it
      --gmail-client-id string   Client ID of your own Google OAuth app (type Desktop app)
  -h, --help                     help for repair
      --imap-host string         IMAP server name, such as imap.example.com
      --imap-port string         IMAP server port (default 993, or 143 with --imap-tls starttls)
      --imap-tls string          IMAP TLS mode: implicit or starttls (default: from the port)
      --smtp-host string         SMTP server name, such as smtp.example.com
      --smtp-port string         SMTP server port (default 465, or 587 with --smtp-tls starttls)
      --smtp-tls string          SMTP TLS mode: implicit or starttls (default: from the port)
      --username string          Username for the IMAP and SMTP servers (default: the email address)

Global Flags:
      --config string     Path to the config file
      --dry-run           Preview changes without performing them
      --include-meta      Wrap the JSON output as {data, meta} with request details
      --jq string         Filter the JSON output with a jq expression
      --json              Output stable JSON instead of the human view
      --no-ansi           Disable all ANSI/control sequences in human output
      --no-color          Disable color in human output
      --no-pager          Never use a pager for long human output
      --no-prompt         Never block on an interactive prompt
      --quiet             Suppress non-essential output
      --template string   Format the JSON output with a Go text/template
